name: NAD83(HARN)
area: American Samoa - onshore - Tutuila, Aunu'u, Ofu, Olesega, Ta'u and Rose islands. Guam - onshore. Northern Mariana Islands - onshore. Puerto Rico - onshore. United States (USA) - onshore plus offshore Gulf of Mexico continental shelf (GoM OCS). US Virgin Islands - onshore.
remarks: In CONUS and Hawaii replaces NAD83 for applications with an accuracy of better than 1m. Replaced by NAD83(FBN) in CONUS, American Samoa and Guam / NMI, by NAD83(NSRS2007) in Alaska, by NAD83(PA11) in Hawaii and by NAD83(HARN Corrected) in PRVI.
